title: Letting nature take over
text:
Rewilding, the practice of allowing land to return to a natural state, has moved from the fringes of conservation into the [[1]]. The idea is to keep human [[2]] to a minimum and let natural processes do the work. Often, large grazing animals such as cattle or ponies are released, because their feeding and trampling help to [[3]] the landscape, creating a mix of open ground, scrub and woodland.

The results can be [[4]]: nobody can say in advance which species will return. In some places, however, the recovery has been [[5]], with beavers, storks and wildcats reappearing after centuries of absence.

Not everyone welcomes the trend. Some farmers fear that their contribution to the countryside is being [[6]] by policies that seem to favour wildlife over food, and they argue that it is [[7]] to take productive land out of use while food prices are rising. Supporters reply that much of the land involved was [[8]] wetland or forest and was never well suited to farming in the first place.

explanation.en: 'From the fringes ... into the' needs a noun that means the opposite of 'fringes': 'the mainstream', the ideas most people accept. The stem combines with 'stream' to form a compound noun.
explanation.cs: Protiklad k 'fringes' (okraj) je 'the mainstream' (hlavní proud). Slovo vzniká spojením main + stream.

explanation.en: 'Keep human ... to a minimum' needs a noun after the adjective 'human': 'intervention'. Note the spelling change: the final -e of the verb disappears before -tion.
explanation.cs: Po přídavném jménu 'human' je třeba podstatné jméno: intervention = zásah. Pozor na pravopis: intervene, intervention.

explanation.en: 'Help to' is followed by a verb in the infinitive, and 'creating a mix' of habitats shows the meaning 'make more varied': 'diversify'. The suffix -ify turns the adjective into a verb.
explanation.cs: Po 'help to' následuje infinitiv slovesa. Zvířata vytvářejí pestrou krajinu, proto diversify = zpestřit, diverzifikovat (přípona -ify).

explanation.en: 'Nobody can say in advance' explains the colon, so the results cannot be foreseen: 'unpredictable'. Two changes: the prefix un- and the suffix -able.
explanation.cs: Za dvojtečkou je vysvětlení: nikdo nedokáže předem říct, co se stane. Proto un- + predict + -able = unpredictable (nepředvídatelný).

explanation.en: 'Has been' needs an adjective, and the return of beavers, storks and wildcats shows a very impressive result: 'spectacular'. The ending -cle changes to -cular.
explanation.cs: Po 'has been' je přídavné jméno; návrat bobrů a čápů je úchvatný: spectacular. Koncovka -cle se mění na -cular.

explanation.en: 'Is being ... by policies' is a passive, and the farmers' fear is that nobody notices their contribution: 'overlooked'. The prefix over- and the -ed participle are both needed.
explanation.cs: Trpný rod (is being + příčestí). Farmáři se bojí, že jejich přínos je přehlížen: over- + look + -ed = overlooked.

explanation.en: The farmers are criticising the policy, so 'it is ... to take productive land out of use' needs a negative adjective: 'irresponsible'. Adjectives beginning with r usually take the prefix ir-.
explanation.cs: Farmáři politiku kritizují, proto záporné přídavné jméno: irresponsible = nezodpovědný. Před r se zápor obvykle tvoří předponou ir-.

explanation.en: An adverb is needed between 'was' and 'wetland' to say what the land was at first: 'originally'. Two steps: origin, original, originally.
explanation.cs: Mezi 'was' a 'wetland' stojí příslovce: originally = původně. Dva kroky: origin, original, originally.
